ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $AC=4$, and $BC=3$. A square $ABDE$ is constructed with $AB$ as its side. What is the area of square $ABDE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} In $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $AC=4$, and $BC=3$,\\
$\therefore$ $AB=\sqrt{AC^2+BC^2}=\sqrt{4^2+3^2}=5$,\\
$\therefore$ the area of the square $ABDE$ is $AB^2=5^2=\boxed{25}$.
